io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.utils

Interface Tag<T>


  • public interface Tag<T>
    Java-8 universal port: drop-in replacement for org.bukkit.Tag (1.13+).

    org.bukkit.Tag is declared Tag<T extends Keyed> and absent on 1.8, so a direct reference fails class-loading there. The constants Slimefun's core already ships are delegated to Tag; the few STB-only tags absent from core (WALL_SIGNS, FLOWERS, WOOL, CARPETS) are resolved here against the server's real tag reflectively, with a name-based Material fallback on legacy versions.

    Call sites only need to swap import org.bukkit.Tag for this class; Tag.X.isTagged(...) and Tag.X.getValues() read identically.
